bandReport.notes: No stem in this band asks for two answers (no TWO_ANSWERS flags). Kept as printed: Q31 option (2) 'digit 1 occurs 1 more time than 1.' (compares 1 with itself, probably a misprint for 'than 2'), option (1) has no full stop; Q40 'occuring' (misspelt); Q42 'Science Center' then 'Science Centre'; Q45 'four wheelers vehicles'; Q49 'consumed very less'; Q59 'number of diameter and radii'; Q62 'Chennama Express'; Q67 'Childrens' Day'; Q73 'grape wine yard' and 'kg.' with a full stop. Q32's subtraction puzzle is typed as a LaTeX array (no figure). Q47-49 share the pictograph: transcribed in context as a pipe table (smiley counts 7, 4, 2, 5 counted from the print) AND given a figure region, since it is a picture graph. Q57 and Q60/Q61 options are printed letters a-d referring to labelled pictures, kept as text. Short subtopic labels used where none fits: Q31 'Counting Digits', Q50 'Like Fractions', Q52 'Perimeter of a Composite Figure', Q57/Q69 'Fractions from Pictures', Q60 'Types of Angles', Q64 'Ream and Quire'.
